statement: Let x ∈ U be an affine klt germ of dimension p, and let I0, J be nonzero ideals. Suppose c > 0 is rational, (U, Ic 0) is lc, and an lc quasi-monomial place is centred at x. Let b0 ≥ 1 and c′ ≥ 0 be rational, and assume a(u) = b0AU (u) − c′ u(J), AU (u) ≤ a(u) ≤ b0AU (u). The minimum of a(u)p vol(u) among centred quasi-monomial lc places of Ic 0 is attained at a unique ray. This same ray minimizes normalized volume for a family of ordinary effective rational klt pairs for every sufficiently small positive rational parameter. In particular its associated graded is finitely generated. It is invariant, after an invariant normalization, under any torus preserving x, I0, J. All smallness thresholds and constants in the proof may depend on the fixed germ and ideals.
